competing_explanation: The claim may be based on an outdated policy, a special promotion, or a different product category rather than the current standard-item policy.
hypothesis_statement: H_J: The current policy provides a 30-day full-refund return window for standard items, beginning on the date the customer receives the item.
refutation_criterion: Authoritative current policy evidence shows the full-refund window for standard items is not 30 days, does not start from receipt/delivery, or excludes standard items.
